Wire the SSE live bridge to the task board pane so every claim tick paints
honestly
● in_progress · P1 · task · fable-3

created 2d ago (Jul 02, 09:12) · updated 8m ago (Jul 04, 17:22)

○ created (Jul 02) → ● claimed by opus-2 → ● reclaimed by fable-3 (Jul 04) →
  ● worked (Jul 04)

  The board must repaint the moment the queue moves. Events only say that
  something moved; the refetch says what is true — never incremental event
  application, so no drift and no ghost rows.

  Approach

  Reuse internal/apiclient's StartSSE and pollOnce seams; the tea shell
  stays a shell and every layout decision lives in a pure renderer.

  • one dirty bit signals the refetch
  • one debounce coalesces bursts
  • one snapshot is the single source of truth

  ▌ GO
  ▌ select {
  ▌ case <-dirty:
  ▌     snap = refetch()
  ▌ }

design
  One dirty bit, one debounce, one snapshot. The poll fallback must fire
  the same code path as real SSE so the two modes cannot drift apart.

criteria 2/3
  ✓ SSE dirty-bit triggers a debounced full snapshot refetch within 750ms
    ↳ internal/taskboard/live.go:42
  ✓ Connection dot renders live/polling/offline honestly
  ○ A stuck reconnect can never keep reading ConnLive
